description: This file defines the Opencart" catalog model class 'Upload' responsible for handling file upload operations, including adding a new upload record and retrieving upload details by code. It interacts with the database to store and fetch upload data.

classes.name: Upload
classes.description: Represents the model for handling upload records within the OpenCart catalog. Provides methods to add an upload and retrieve an upload by its code.

methods.name: addUpload
methods.description: Inserts a new upload record into the database with the given name and filename, generates a unique code, and returns the code.

methods.name: getUploadByCode
methods.description: Retrieves upload record details from the database matching the provided code.
